title: Fee Modulation Plastic 2027 – Circulair Plastics | Verpact
text:
Fee Modulation Plastic 2027 – Circulair Plastics
Discount tiers for the use of recyclate (PCR) and/or bio-based drop-ins
Through the Circular Plastics scheme, we encourage the use of circular raw materials in plastic packaging. This not only reduces reliance on fossil-based materials but also stimulates investment in recycling capacity and increases the availability of high-quality recyclate. In doing so, we support the transition toward an increasingly circular plastic packaging value chain.
Do you use recyclate (PCR) or bio-based drop-ins? We reward every kilogram with a discount on the rate: the more circular plastic incorporated into your packaging, the higher the discount. As of 2027, there is no longer a maximum percentage cap; using 100% recyclate and/or bio-based drop-ins still qualifies for a discount, up to a maximum of €0.78 per kg.
The discount amount depends on the packaging category and the country of origin of the recyclate or bio-based drop-ins. If the material originates from a country on our list, you receive the full discount. If it comes from another country, you receive one-quarter of the discount.
What is changing compared to 2026?
| Overview of of circulair plastics | 2027 | 2026 | 
| Discount for using recyclate | up to €0,78 per kg | €0,20 per kg | 
| Discount on bio-based drop-ins | up to €0,78 per kg | No discount | 
| Origin recyclate or bio-based drop-ins | country on the list: full discount; other country: one-quarter of the discount | No distinction between countries. | 
| Percentage calculation | Per packaging category subject to the material tariff for rigid or flexible plastic. | Per disposable unit | 
| Which types of packaging are eligible? | All kilograms of plastic subject to the plastic material rate. | Packaging consisting of at least 50 percent plastic (by weight) | 
| Maximum discount Design for Recycling + Circular plastics + | Design for Recycling: €0,40 per kg Circulair plastics: €0,78 per kg Total: €1,18 per kg | Design for Recycling: €0,40 per kg Use of recyclate: €0,20 per kg Total: €0,60 per kg | 
Example: Circular plastics discount for the use of 100% PCR and/or bio-based drop-in material.
| Packaging category | Wat valt hieronder? | Examples | Discount PCR*/ Biobased Drop-in | 
| Food-contact PET packaging (excluding beverage bottles) | Packaging with PET as the main component  | PET-salad trays PET packages Etc. | For usage up to and including 30%, the discount is €0.20. Above 30%, the additional discount is €0.025. The maximum discount is €0.78. | 
| Food-contact non-PET packaging (excluding beverage bottles) | Packaging made of a plastic other than PET | PP bag for dog food PE jar for skin cream PP tube with toothpaste Etc. | For an inclusion rate of up to 10%, the discount is €0.20. Above 10%, the additional discount is €0.05. The maximum discount is €0.65 per kg. | 
| Touch-sensitive beverage bottles (excluding deposit) | All plastic beverage bottles outside the deposit system | PET bottle with yogurt drink Organic PE bottle with milk | For usage up to and including 30%, the discount is €0.20. Above 30%, the additional discount is €0.025. The maximum discount is €0.78. | 
| Non-contact-sensitive packaging | All packaging that does not fall into a contact-sensitive category | PET packaging for screws PE bag for clothing Etc. | For a contribution of up to 35%, the amount is €0.05. Above 35%, the additional discount is €0.025. The maximum discount is €0.3375 per kg. |
